cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)
project(rv32emu LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

file(GLOB_RECURSE RADCPP_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS src/*.cpp src/*.c)
file(GLOB_RECURSE RADCPP_HEADERS CONFIGURE_DEPENDS include/*.hpp include/*.h)
add_executable(rv32emu ${RADCPP_SOURCES} ${RADCPP_HEADERS})
target_include_directories(rv32emu PRIVATE include)

include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/project.cmake OPTIONAL)
